I don't trust Belgium; Doku tried to dive for a penalty, Lukaku claimed an Egypt own goal as his, and De Cuyper should have got a second yellow for when he bear hugged Zizo to the ground in the box.Bit of dirty play from Belgium to make it through a match they struggled with.

Germany wins it 7-1 against Curaçao! Congrats to Germany and kudos to Curaçao for playing as well as they did for their first game! ​

Also hearing Balogun has also topped this with Havertz: ‘Kai Havertz is now the joint-top scorer at the 2026 FIFA World Cup’ ‘The Arsenal forward scored a brace as Germany beat Curaçao 7-1 in their World Cup opener’ (World Cup 26 News)
Germany hits 239 goals! An emphatic 7-1 win over Curaçao sets a new World Cup scoring record.
A host country always has a bit more energy, but my god the work rate is incredible. Out of possession, they are closing down Paraguay and turning them right back over. Dream start.
Another goal from the US, this time by them. 2-0 over Paraguay.
Going into halftime, and at the buzzer, 3-0 United States over Paraguay. Pure domination.
3-0 right before half time. Poor Paraguay. They have a whole other half still to go...
Wow, Qatar draws level deep into stoppage time. Quality cross and a thumping header. Switzerland have been far better, but wasteful. Massive point for Qatar.

last minute draw was magical. They didn't give in, but let them in.It was known that Quatar would have at least a couple of opportunities, the problem was capitalizing them. Complacence by Switzerland = 2 points lost.Everyone in the group is tied now with 1 point. LOL.
This game ends in a draw. 1-1 for Switzerland and Qatar.
SBB CFF FFS, Switzerland. You’re meant to be neutral, not useless.
